description: CsNa₂Mn₃P₄O₁₄Cl crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Cs is bonded in a 14-coordinate geometry to twelve O and two equivalent Cl atoms. There are a spread of Cs-O bond distances ranging from 3.24-3.76 Å. Both Cs-Cl bond lengths are 3.52 Å. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.65 Å. There are two inequivalent Mn sites. In the first Mn site, Mn is bonded to five O and one Cl atom to form distorted MnClO₅ square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one MnClO₅ square pyramid and corners with five PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.23 Å. The Mn-Cl bond length is 3.05 Å. In the second Mn site, Mn is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two equivalent Cl atoms. There are two shorter (2.03 Å) and two longer (2.42 Å) Mn-O bond lengths. There is one shorter (2.56 Å) and one longer (2.79 Å) Mn-Cl bond length. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent MnClO₅ square pyramids and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.64 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnClO₅ square pyramids and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.64 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Cs, one Mn, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Cs, one Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Cs and two P atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Cs, two equivalent Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Mn and one P atom. Cl is bonded to two equivalent Cs and four Mn atoms to form distorted corner-sharing ClCs₂Mn₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
